title: ChatGPT Just Copied Claude — And That Tells You Everything
description:
ChatGPT just made its biggest change in months — and honestly, it copied Claude. Everyone's talking about the new models. That's not the real story.

The real change: they've pulled chat, work, and Codex into one place. Sound familiar? It's exactly what Claude did when it brought everything into Cowork.

"Work" is now ChatGPT's version of agentic AI. It can go off and do tasks for you — not just answer questions.

When the two biggest players start copying each other, it tells you where this is heading. Agentic AI isn't a trend. It's becoming the normal way we work.
